title: Duluth Ghost Tours shows off hometown haunts
excerpt: Duluth Ghost Tours offers guided walks through Canal Park, sharing local history and stories of paranormal activity.
content:
Ghosts in Duluth? Why not!

Duluth Ghost Tours offers guided walks through Canal Park, sharing local history and stories of paranormal activity.

“Captain Kim” Christine with Duluth Ghost Tours leads the tours and includes a paranormal investigation as part of the experience.

She took Lea Zmurko on a walking tour of Canal Park, sharing the saying “the lake never gives up her dead.” She explained that records show about 350 ships have gone down, but some say up to 600, with 10,000 bodies lost.

Kim said she has always been into the paranormal.

“All my family is Scandinavian, so I really didn’t have any witchy family members at all,” she said. “So it was just one thing that, you know, being an only child, I loved watching spooky movies. So that was really when I started to get into a lot of it.”

She decided to move to Duluth because of the history of Canal Park.

“I talk a lot about the Suites Hotel. I’ve had a lot of personal experiences there. Then one room in particular, room 401, I had the most experience of hauntings,” Christine said.

The tour ends with a paranormal investigation, when people can experience an EVP session using a “spirit box,” which is an AM-FM radio that scans stations and creates white noise.

“I’ll tell people, these are the different questions to ask. But you also need to be a skeptic as well,” Kim said.

According to Kim, the voices heard through the EVP sessions are often strange but sometimes directly answer questions, like when a spirit said “brisket” in response to a question about what food they miss. Other answers have included Cheetos, pizza, fajitas and ribs.

She lets everyone on the tour ask questions, but some people choose to pass if they are uncomfortable.

The Duluth Ghost Tours experience combines local history with interactive paranormal investigations for those interested in the supernatural.
